content:
samir: FYI I'm kicking off qx3b-int4 bring-up tomorrow morning. main risk: locale long-tail (pt_BR/ko/ru) and code-mixed prompts causing quality regressions. need a small curated promptset + golden add-ons before canary.
li: got it. what's the golden target size? and do we reuse the existing microcanaries or make a fresh holdout? :thinking:
nora: i'd prefer a fresh micro-holdout for qx3b to catch quant-specific regressions. reuse some seeds but add ~500 new longtail examples.
sanctions-bot: (automated) Reminder: labeling budget expiring in 3 days.
anika: labelops can do 1.8k/day for a 3-day sprint if we prioritize. we should split by locale and tag synthetic-looking samples for close review.
samir: plan: 1) sample 2k candidate prompts focused on long-tail locales + code-mix 2) de-dupe against holdout hashlist 3) split 1.2k labelable + 800 golden candidates 4) labelops runs golden review. needs consensus on dedupe threshold.
li: propose dedupe_threshold=0.85 semantic sim (embed cosine), but for exact token overlap use 0.95. also exclude prefixes from kvcache collisions.
marcus: for quant artifacts we saw regressions at token boundaries. include a small set of long-sequence prompts (>=1024 tokens) to stress int4 path.
labelops-bot: suggested sampling config attached:
```
mode: focused
locales: ["pt_BR","ko","ru","en-IN"]
min_tokens: 30
max_tokens: 1600
semantic_dedupe: 0.85
exact_dedupe: 0.95
golden_fraction: 0.18
exclude_hashlists: ["holdout_main_2025","canary_qx3b_seed"]
```
li: ok. can we also add a small adverse set where prompts are adversarial to formatting/parsing (markdown tables, mixed json/code)? Those triggered hallucination deltas in previous int4 runs.
samir: yes add ~150 adversarials. nora please create the seed list and mark them with tag 'adversarial-int4'.
nora: on it. I'll upload to the curation bucket, path: https://redwood.internal/curation/qx3b/longtail-2025-03. I'll also attach provenance metadata.
anika: labeling plan: 1) quick triage 2) golden double-review for 800 items 3) escalation to samir if disagreement >15%. timeline: start tomorrow 09:00 UTC, finish by +72h.
samir: perfect. can someone set up a lightweight eval harness to run cross-model BLEU/ROUGE plus crit-rate for the golden set? want side-by-side vs qx3b-fp16 and qx3b-int8.
marcus: i'll wire a smoke job (low cost) and post results in this thread. expecting initial pass within 12h of canary.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2025-03-15T02:00:00Z -> qx3b-int4 on dedicated test pool. notify: #eng-runtime, #eng-sre.
li: one more ask — please include tokenizer-variant checks; tokenization drift caused a couple false positives before.
samir: added. final checklist: sampling config + dedupe lists + labelops ready + harness wired + canary scheduled. if no blockers we'll proceed tomorrow. :rocket: 
labelops-bot: Ack. Labeling slots reserved.
marcus: posting the initial smoke results in ~10h.
li: thanks everyone, will monitor quality dashboards and ping if we see regressions >5% on golden crit-rate.
samir: thanks — will follow up with a short doc and attach promptset link after nora uploads.
